credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe in profile, standing at the edge of the river, dressed in a long sleeve jacket and matching skirt with her black brimmed hat hanging on her back.  This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Standing at Edge of Water
